errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis categories (HotpotQA, 2Wiki, MuSiQue, Bamboogle) are arranged in alphabetical order. The actual order is not alphabetical.
In the '2Wiki' category, the value for the 'Tool-Star-3B(Web)' mode is stated to be approximately 54, but the bar is visually closer to 53.
In the 'MuSiQue' category, the value for the 'Tool-Star-3B(Web)' mode is stated to be approximately 22, but the bar is visually much lower, only slightly above 20 (approximately 21).
In the 'Bamboogle' category, the value for the 'Tool-Star-3B(Web)' mode is stated to be approximately 60, but the bar is visibly just over the 60 line, closer to 61.
The description states that the datasets on the horizontal axis are listed in alphabetical order, but they are not. The order is HotpotQA, 2Wiki, MuSiQue, Bamboogle.
The description states the legend is in the top right ('oben rechts'), but it is located in the top left of the chart.
